mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, activity_id, area_id, position_id, user_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, assignment_status FROM schedule_assignment WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, plan_id, activity_id, area_id, position_id, user_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, assignment_status FROM schedule_assignment WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY work_date ASC, start_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, plan_id, activity_id, area_id, position_id, user_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, assignment_status FROM schedule_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY work_date ASC, start_time ASC, id ASC
